Name: Public disclosure for proposed construction or conversion of buildings operating as shelters.
Title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the City of New York, in relation to public disclosure for proposed construction or conversion of buildings operating as shelters

History.Description: This Introduction was Introduced by Council
This Introduction was Referred to Comm by Council to the Committee on Housing and Buildings

Summary: This bill would require an operation statement and any updated operation statement to be included in construction documents by a permit applicant for proposed construction or conversion of apartment hotels, transient hotels, or any other buildings considered appropriate by the Department of Buildings (DOB). The statement would require disclosure on whether the applicant intends to use the building as a hotel open to the general public or as a shelter. If the intended use is for a shelter, the statement would include the intended capacity, the population to be served, the agency responsible for placement, and where relevant the nonprofit or private operator responsible for day-to-day management. The statement and any updated statements would be made publicly available and shared with the relevant Borough President, Council Member, and community board before DOB approves documents and grants work permits. An applicant or owner would be required to update their operation statements if there are any material changes to the intended use of a building, the intended capacity of the facility, or the population to be served or once an operator is identified before the construction or conversion of a building has been completed.
Text:
A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the City of New York, in relation to public disclosure for proposed construction or conversion of buildings operating as shelters

Be it enacted by the Council as follows:


Section 1. Section 28-103.25 of the administrative code of the city of New York, as added by local law number 45 for the year 2015, is amended to read as follows:
§ 28-103.25 Hotel and other building development plans. [Where] No later than 15 business days after the department receives applications or updated operation statements for new construction of or conversions to apartment hotels or transient hotels, as such terms are defined in the zoning resolution, or any other buildings the commissioner considers appropriate, in accordance with the requirements of article 121 of this chapter, the department shall provide [written notice, or] notice by electronic mail, or by mail where the electronic mail address of the intended recipient is not available to the department, of the proposed construction or conversion, including a copy of the operation statement and any updated operation statement submitted to the department in accordance with the requirements of article 121 of this chapter, to:
1. The borough president of the borough in which such proposed construction is located;
2. The council member in whose district such proposed construction is located;
3. The community board of the community district in which such proposed construction is located; and
4. If such proposed construction involves land within two or more community districts in a borough, the borough board.
§ 2. Article 104 of chapter 1 of title 28 of the administrative code of the city of New York is amended by adding a new section 28-104.7.19 to read as follows:
§ 28-104.7.19 Operation statements. The title sheet of construction documents shall contain a statement requiring that an operation statement be submitted in accordance with the requirements of article 121 of this chapter prior to the issuance of a permit for the proposed construction or conversion of an apartment hotel or transient hotel, as such terms are defined in the zoning resolution, or any other building that the commissioner considers appropriate, in accordance with the requirements of article 121 of this chapter.
§ 3. Chapter 1 of title 28 of the administrative code of the city of New York is amended by adding a new article 121 to read as follows:
ARTICLE 121
OPERATION STATEMENT
§ 28-121.1 Submission of operation statement. 
     a. Definitions. For purposes of this section, the term "shelter" means any form of temporary housing, including emergency housing, provided to homeless individuals or families by the city or a provider under contract or similar agreement with the city.
     b. A permit applicant shall prepare and submit an operation statement for any new construction or conversion of apartment hotels or transient hotels, as such terms are defined in the zoning resolution, and any other buildings considered appropriate by the commissioner. In making such determination, the commissioner shall consider types of buildings that could be used as a shelter, including community facilities, as defined in the zoning resolution. The operation statement shall be signed by the owner of the building and the permit applicant and shall include a declaration as to whether the applicant intends to use the building or portion of the building as open to the general public or as a shelter. If the applicant intends to use the building as a shelter, the applicant shall include a statement of intended use that includes, to the extent known by the applicant, the intended capacity of the facility, the population to be served, the city agency responsible for placement, and where relevant the nonprofit or private operator responsible for day-to-day management of the facility. Such operation statement shall be filed with the department pursuant to section 28-104.7.19. 
     c. An applicant or owner shall submit an updated operation statement to the department if there is any material change to the intended use of a building, the intended capacity of a facility, or the population to be served or a nonprofit or private operator responsible for day-to-day management of a facility has been identified before the construction or conversion of a building has been completed. Such updated operation statement shall be submitted to the department no later than 7 days after the applicant or owner knows or reasonably should know of such change or identification.
§ 28-121.2 Department review and permits. The relevant borough president, council member, community board, or borough board may submit comments to the department concerning the operation statement and any updated operation statement. Such comments shall be submitted no later than 7 days after the commissioner provides the notice required by section 28-103.25. Any such comments received by such time shall be considered by the department prior to the issuance of a permit for the new construction or conversion of a building or prior to the approval of any changes to a permit for the new construction or conversion of a building. The commissioner shall not issue a permit for work that requires an operation statement under this article unless such statement is considered complete by the department. The commissioner may consult with the department of homeless services, department of social services, or any other relevant agency before considering an operation statement complete.
§ 28-121.3 Public availability of operation statement. No later than 15 business days prior to the issuance of a permit for work requiring an operation statement under this article, the commissioner shall publish such operation statement on the website of the department. No later than 15 business days after receiving an updated operation statement, the commissioner shall publish such updated operation statement on the website of the department.
§ 4. This local law takes effect 120 days after it becomes law.
